proposals.evidenceText: Figure 1.1 charts selected global connectivity indicators from 1994 to 2025 in millions. Its labelled 2025 endpoints are 9,171 mobile-cellular subscriptions, 8,175 active mobile-broadband subscriptions, 6,047 Internet users, 1,654 fixed-broadband subscriptions and 815 fixed telephone lines. The figure reports counts in millions, not rates or unique subscribers.
proposals.reason: Full-size physical page 19 / printed page 8 checked; five 2025 endpoint labels and chart units are visible.

proposals.evidenceText: Table 1.1 presents selected supercomputing milestones for 1993, 1997, 2008, 2022 and 2024, with performance, units, numeric FLOPS, an indexed comparison and named systems. It is a historical milestone table, not a connectivity coverage measure.
proposals.reason: Full-size physical page 20 / printed page 9 checked; the table has factual rows and column relationships.
